title: Consumer Behavior in Tourism
duration: 45 hours (30 hours of lectures and 15 hours of seminars/practicals)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze consumer behavior in tourism, including the factors influencing it.
Apply knowledge of consumer behavior to tourism marketing strategies.
Conduct research on consumer behavior in tourism, including data analysis and interpretation.
Design and manage customer experiences in the tourism industry.
Evaluate and predict future trends in consumer behavior in tourism.
Work effectively in teams to analyze and present research findings.
Effectively communicate research findings and insights through presentations.
Manage time effectively to meet deadlines and participate in class activities.
Demonstrate ethical behavior in academic and professional settings.
